title: Smooth Representations And Character Isotypic Subspaces
body_html:
Smooth Representations And Character Isotypic Subspaces

Let $G$ be a locally profinite group and let $R$ be a commutative ring. The category $\operatorname{Rep}_R(G)$ consists of smooth $R[G]$-modules: an $R$-module $V$ with an $R$-linear $G$-action such that every vector has open stabilizer.

Let $K\subset G$ be compact and let $\psi:K\to R^\times$ be a character. For $V\in\operatorname{Rep}_R(K)$, define

$$ V^\psi:=\{v\in V:k\cdot v=\psi(k)v\text{ for all }k\in K\}. $$

If $K$ has invertible pro-order in $R$, the draft identifies $V^\psi$ with the $\psi$-coinvariants

$$ V_\psi:=V/V[\psi], $$

where

$$ V[\psi]= \langle k\cdot v-\psi(k)v:k\in K,\ v\in V\rangle. $$

For a ring morphism $R\to R'$, the draft asserts the scalar-extension formula

$$ V^\psi\otimes_R R' \simeq (V\otimes_R R')^{\psi_{R'}}. $$

Draft Caution

The TeX proof uses the central idempotent $e_{K,\psi}$ in a Hecke algebra. The draft has minor prose errors, but the intended statement is clear.
